# archer

The always-on box. Runs the token broker, the mail webhooks and the backup target for [theater](obsidian://open?vault=vault&file=infra%2Ftheater).

## Backups

- Nightly at 03:00 to the second disk
- Weekly to the cloud bucket, encrypted

note:infra/theater.md.markdown:
# theater

A small box under the TV that runs the media stack and the reader. Caddy fronts everything on it, one hostname per service.

> **Note**
> Every service gets its own `.lan` name; Caddy reads the list from `sites.yml` and reloads on change.

## Services

| service | port | what |
|---|---|---|
| read | 8791 | the ebook reader, [ken](obsidian://open?vault=vault&file=personal%2Fprojects%2Fken) feeds it |
| photos | 2283 | the photo library |
| bak | 8790 | the published-files viewer |

## Gotchas

- The disk spins down after 20 min; the first request after that takes 4 s.
- A reboot needs the vault mounted first, see [infra/archer](obsidian://open?vault=vault&file=infra%2Farcher).

```sh
ssh theater systemctl --user restart caddy
```

note:personal/projects/ken.md.markdown:
# ken

A feed reader. Pulls the feeds every hour, writes one digest a day, keeps read state itself so the mail is only a nudge.

## Decisions

1. One digest a day, not two: the second was never opened.
2. Read state lives in ken, not in the mail client.
3. Runs on [theater](obsidian://open?vault=vault&file=infra%2Ftheater), next to the reader it feeds.
